caption:
Koko carries every shopping bag home in one hand, and lately the outside of her elbow aches.

The muscles you grip with attach near the outer elbow. Bags hooked on the fingers mean gripping hard the whole way home, which can leave that area feeling sore.

Hybi's elbow care: split bags across both hands, use a trolley or backpack for heavy loads, and try a wrist-up hold against your other hand, 30 seconds × 5, keeping it to mild discomfort.

A swollen or warm elbow, tingling fingers, or no change after a few weeks are worth an assessment. Our Chatswood and Sydney CBD physios can help. Book online via the link in bio
